name: VA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +26 partisan lean
Incumbent Don Beyer seeking re-election with a large fundraising edge
Republican challenger minimally funded and little known
Markets price Beyer near-certain to win
model.rationale: Beyer holds a deep-blue seat with a +26 Democratic lean, has raised over $2.1 million against a Republican challenger with about $22,000, and prediction markets give him roughly 96% odds. No polling or ratings suggest any threat, so the fundamentals-based margin stands.
model.watch: A surprise late outside-spending blitz or an unusually strong third-party showing could shave the margin, but nothing realistic flips the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northern Virginia's 8th District is one of the most Democratic seats in Virginia, with a partisan lean of about 26 points toward Democrats. Don Beyer, the incumbent since 2015, is running for re-election and has built a commanding financial position, raising over $2.1 million and holding more than $800,000 on hand.

His Republican opponent, Tony Sabio, has raised only about $22,000, and independent and Libertarian candidates lack meaningful resources. Prediction markets put Beyer's chances near 96%, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. With no public polling and no signs of a serious challenge, the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable Beyer victory.
